name: Storj Object Storage
tax_note: Docs pricing overview: 'US sales tax will be included on all US invoices in accordance with state and local regulations (effective November 1, 2025).' Nothing is stated for other countries.

regions.note: Single hosted gateway endpoint that routes to the nearest gateway instance automatically. Storj docs do not document a SigV4 signing region; 'us1' is a placeholder value (posts on the Storj community forum say the region field is ignored). Data placement is chosen per bucket by location constraint (global-1, regional-1, archive-1; legacy global, us-select-1), not by region. Country ZZ = globally distributed, not a single country.

storage_classes.name: Standard

price.note: Simplified pricing doc (effective July 1, 2026): storage $7/TB/month; converted to per GB with Storj's stated base-10 units ('1 TB = 1,000 GB'). Storage is measured hourly and the monthly total is rounded up to a whole GB per tier. Standard = globally distributed placement (successor of Global Collaboration, Active Archive and Legacy Global; location constraints global-1 / archive-1).

put_per_1000.note: Pricing page FAQ: 'No API fees'; segment fees 'have been eliminated across all new tiers' (they still apply to legacy plans).

typical_delay.note: Not stated in the sources checked.

minimum_storage_duration_days.note: Simplified pricing doc: 'Data deleted before 30 days will still be billed for the full 1 month period'; Object Mount users are excluded.

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: Simplified pricing doc: minimum object size 50 kB (base-10 units); smaller objects are billed as 50 kB.

notes: Minimum monthly fee $5 for active storage accounts (a floor on the invoice, not a credit); USDC-paying accounts and the free trial are exempt (simplified pricing doc).
Projects created before July 1, 2026 moved from legacy or tiered pricing; EU customers had to opt in by July 30, 2026 (pricing overview doc https://storj.dev/dcs/pricing).

price.note: Simplified pricing doc (effective July 1, 2026): storage $10/TB/month; converted to per GB with Storj's stated base-10 units ('1 TB = 1,000 GB'). Storage is measured hourly and the monthly total is rounded up to a whole GB per tier. Advanced = region-specific storage in US SOC 2 Type 2 facilities (successor of Regional Workflows and Legacy US Select; location constraint regional-1).

free_allowance_gb_per_month.note: No free egress allowance is listed; egress is billed per GB (monthly total rounded up to a whole GB per tier).

price.note: Simplified pricing doc: egress $7/TB for both Standard and Advanced; converted with 1 TB = 1,000 GB as stated by Storj. Bandwidth includes all data transferred out of the Storj network.

egress_fair_use.note: No egress fair-use rule is stated; the pricing page reserves the right to apply minimum retention fees or restrict service for Object Mount usage with disproportionate infrastructure load.

free_tier.value: Free trial of Object Storage with Object Mount: $0 for 30 days, works with S3-compatible apps, no credit card required, 2 free Object Mount licenses.
free_tier.note: The Object Mount section of the page mentions '25GB free storage for 30 days' for the trial. No permanent free tier.

object_lock.note: S3 Object Lock with governance mode, compliance mode and legal hold, via the hosted gateway.

s3_endpoints.label: Global (auto-routed)
s3_endpoints.note: Hosted gateway endpoint routes to the closest instance automatically. Path-style: Storj's s3fs guide (https://storj.dev/dcs/third-party-tools/s3fs) mounts with use_path_request_style; no general recommendation found. The rclone quickstart uses provider = Storj with this endpoint.

notes: Copying via CopyObject is limited to about 671 GB per object (S3 compatibility doc https://storj.dev/dcs/api/s3/s3-compatibility).
Object Mount licenses (Teams $29/license/month incl. 500 GB storage) are not modelled.
